candidate.title: Find most frequent artist in personalized recommendations
candidate.applicability: Music-service tasks asking which artist appears most in personalized recommendations returned as paginated songs with nested artists.
procedure: Check recommendation API docs for authentication, pagination limits, and nested artist response shape.
Login and keep the access token required for personalized recommendations.
Fetch pages using max allowed page size; stop on empty or short page.
Flatten artists arrays from all songs.
Count occurrences by stable artist ID while storing display names.
Return the display name of the highest-count artist.
Confirm aggregation covered all pages before answering.
pitfalls: Personalized data may require a valid access token.
Recommendations may be songs, not artist rankings; aggregate nested artists.
Page size may be capped; invalid limits can fail.
One page may omit the top artist.
Counting songs can misrank artists with multiple tracks.
